svg.title: Frames and coordinates
svg.desc: Command: frames, What it does: List registered main/cross-origin frame document IDs; refresh after navigation.; Command: frame <id> <operation> --args '<json>', What it does: Explicit frame-local snapshot/observe/extract/get/watch/eval/click/fill/check/uncheck/select; arguments at most 64 KiB.; Command: pointer <action> --x n --y n, What it does: Trusted left-button click/move/down/up at CSS viewport coordinates; no inferred canvas semantics or application-effect verification.
